description:
Assistant Criminal Analysts (ACAs) are contemplated as contractor support personnel who would provide administrative, research, data-processing, and analytical assistance to Government Criminal Analysts, criminal investigators, and law-enforcement personnel. Anticipated activities include organizing analytical files; collecting, processing, and evaluating information; preparing draft analytical products; supporting lead development and deconfliction; documenting investigative activity; and preparing materials for Government review and approval. 

 In addition to general ACA support, ICE is considering specialized Criminal Analyst Subject Matter Expert labor categories at the Associate and Principal levels. These categories may include all-source and open-source analysis, financial analysis, international trade and counterproliferation, cryptocurrency and blockchain, screening and vetting, cyber analysis, fraud analysis, data science and artificial intelligence, national security, human trafficking, and child-exploitation investigative analysis.
